verdict.rationale: Morph advertises full OpenAI SDK/API compatibility at api.morphllm.com/v1 (morph-docs-1), which implies standard streaming support, but no evidence explicitly documents SSE/token-by-token streaming, a `stream` parameter, or any latency/responsiveness benchmarks for streamed output. missing for 10: explicit docs or examples showing `stream=true`/SSE usage, first-party or community confirmation of token-by-token streaming behavior, and any measured time-to-first-token metrics.
